methodology: Institutional original webpage or festival program line-anchored paraphrases, with Murcia Caravaca festival page available only as indexed excerpt and therefore lacking stable HTML lines. Includes 2026 programme-specific descriptions, costume/theatrical scenes, folklore history and official feast observances; they are ONE component of one of THREE local festival complexes, not independent customs. Elche plays sacred drama but staged baptism or funerary gestures are not liturgical sacraments to repeat. Medieval claims require original archival verification. Never infer compatibility with 1962 Missal or ecclesiastical endorsement from tourism promotion; no text/prayers reproduced. Supplemented by detailed Caravaca municipal source on the actual 1–5 May religious sequence, preserving nine reported rites as action/context proposals rather than certifying nine approved 1962 ritual formulas; explicitly notes May 1 unblessed flowers versus May 2 blessing.

critical_notes: Data consistency: classification counts recomputed after supplementary Caravaca municipal passage.
Elche religious theatre scenes are NOT themselves sacramental Catholic rites; simulated baptism, bodily Assumption, coronation and staged funerary gestures remain under one performance complex.
Berga source observations tagged EXPLICIT_2026_PROGRAM are year-specific, not timeless liturgical dates or universal prescriptions.
Caravaca 2026 and later historic ceremonial descriptions do not prove the minister's 1962 Roman Ritual authorization, the truth of locust-clearing miracles, or all reported papal privileges.
